outputs.explanation: Panel A shows percentage contribution values with no significance comparisons or asterisks; no statistical test is claimed or required.
Panel B is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot; no statistical test applies.
Panel C is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot; no statistical test applies.
The plot uses asterisks to denote significance, and the caption names the statistical test used (two-tailed Student's t-test).
Panel E is a series of representative micrographs and pseudocolored images, not a plot with statistical comparisons.
Panel F shows normalized area data with individual points and a fitted curve, but no significance markers or comparisons requiring a statistical test.
Panel G shows normalized roundness data with a fitted curve, but no significance markers or comparisons requiring a statistical test.
Panel H shows normalized length data with a fitted curve, but no significance markers or comparisons requiring a statistical test.
Panel I is a time-lapse series of representative micrographs, not a plot; no statistical test applies.
Panel J shows photobleaching decay curves with shaded error regions but no significance comparisons or asterisks requiring a statistical test.
